DROP VIEW [EDS].[PBI_VIEW_CBC01_RBB_CUSTOMER]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [EDS].[PBI_VIEW_CBC01_RBB_CUSTOMER]
AS SELECT 
 CUST.ORGKEY [Customer ID]
, CUST.Name [Customer Name]
, CONCAT(CUST.Name, ' - ', CUST.ORGKEY)  [Customer Name ID]
, GENDER.DESCRIPTION Gender
, CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE [Customer Since]
, EMAIL.EMAIL Email
, PHONE.PHONENO Mobile
, CONCAT(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1, ' ', CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ', CUST.City, ' ', CUST.[State], ' ', CUST.Zip, ' ', CUST.Country) [Address]
, MARITAL.DESCRIPTION [Marital Status]
, OCCUPATION.DESCRIPTION Occupation
, CONCAT(DATENAME(MONTH, CUST.CUST_DOB), ' ', YEAR(CUST.CUST_DOB))  [Date of Birth]
, KYC.KYC_DATE [Last KYC Date]
, 'TBD' [Risk Rating Type]
, 'TBD' [Risk Rating Name]
, 'TBD' [ATM Cash Card]
, 'TBD' [Mobile Banking]
, 'TBD' [Online Banking]
, CONSENT.DESCRIPTION [Data Privacy Consent]
, CUST.BANK_ID [Bank ID]
, CASE WHEN LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' THEN 'Retail' ELSE 'Unknown' END [Customer Type]
, CUST.CORE_CUST_ID [CUST_ID]
, CUST.SCD_Start_date [Validity Start Date]
, CUST.SCD_End_Date [Validity End Date]
, CUST.SOURCE_CODE
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
INNER JOIN EDS.MV_GENDER GENDER ON GENDER.[VALUE] = CUST.GENDER
INNER JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY, MARITAL_STATUS FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01') DEMO ON DEMO.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY
INNER JOIN EDS.MV_MARITAL_STATUS MARITAL ON MARITAL.[VALUE] = DEMO.MARITAL_STATUS
INNER JOIN (SELECT MISC.ORGKEY, CONSENT.DESCRIPTION 
FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO MISC
LEFT JOIN [EDS].[MV_CONSENT] CONSENT ON CONSENT.BANK_ID = MISC.BANK_ID AND CONSENT.[VALUE] = MISC.STRTEXT13
WHERE MISC.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND MISC.TYPE = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE' AND MISC.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL) CONSENT ON CONSENT.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY
INNER JOIN 

(SELECT BANK_ID, ORGKEY, EMAIL  FROM (
SELECT BANK_ID, ORGKEY, EMAIL,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ORGKEY, BANK_ID  ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) as SEQ_NO
FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL 
WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' AND PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y' AND ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL AND  LEFT(ORGKEY,1) = 'R'
) AS X
WHERE  SEQ_NO = 1) EMAIL ON EMAIL.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

INNER JOIN
    (
    SELECT BANK_ID, ORGKEY, PHONENO  FROM 
    (
        SELECT BANK_ID, ORGKEY, PHONENO,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ORGKEY, BANK_ID  ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) as SEQ_NO
        FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL 
        WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' AND PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y' AND ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL AND  LEFT(ORGKEY,1) = 'R'
) AS X
WHERE  SEQ_NO = 1) PHONE ON PHONE.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

INNER JOIN EDS.MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION OCCUPATION ON OCCUPATION.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID AND OCCUPATION.[VALUE] = CUST.OCCUPATION

INNER JOIN 
(SELECT ORGKEY, BANK_ID, KYC_DATE  FROM (
SELECT ORGKEY, BANK_ID, KYC_DATE,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ORGKEY, BANK_ID  ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) as SEQ_NO
FROM BUSC.CRM_AMLKYC 
WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL AND  LEFT(ORGKEY,1) = 'R'
) AS X
WHERE  SEQ_NO = 1) KYC ON KYC.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

WHERE CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' AND CUST.isLatest = 1 AND CUST.isActive = 1;
GO
